article.headline: Ipswich relegated from Premier League after loss at Newcastle
article.description: Ipswich Town were relegated from the Premier League on Saturday following a 3-0 defeat away to Newcastle United.
article.linkText: Ipswich relegated after 3-0 loss at Newcastle

images.name: How Ipswich's relegation made Premier League history
images.caption: Take a look at the statistics behind Ipswich's relegation from the Premier League.

article.story:
Ipswich Town were relegated from the Premier League on Saturday following a 3-0 defeat at Newcastle United, with the visitors reduced to 10 men after Ben Johnson was sent off for picking up two yellow cards in the first half.

Ipswich have 21 points, 15 behind West Ham United with four games left, while Newcastle moved up to third place on 62, five behind second-placed Arsenal and one ahead of Manchester City in fourth in the race for Champions League football next season.

Needing a victory to have any mathematical chance of staying up, the scale of the task facing the visitors quickly became apparent as Newcastle attacked in waves and had a goal disallowed in the 22nd minute when Bruno Guimarães was found to have obstructed goalkeeper Alex Palmer.

Things went from bad to worse for Ipswich when Johnson was booked for diving in the 30th minute and sent off seven minutes later as he picked up his second yellow card for pulling back Alexander Isak.

As the break approached, Sandro Tonali fired a shot off the woodwork before Newcastle finally took the lead in first-half stoppage time, Isak scoring from the spot after Julio Enciso was penalised for pulling down Jacob Murphy.

With Newcastle raining crosses and set-pieces into the box, Dan Burn netted the second with a header 11 minutes after the break, climbing highest to steer the ball home from close range.

By now 10-man Ipswich were hanging on but there was no respite as Newcastle brought Anthony Gordon, Callum Wilson and William Osula off the bench.

Osula had an immediate impact by netting a towering header from a corner two minutes after coming on to consign Ipswich to the drop into the Championship.
